purpose: Acknowledge a discard without changing bytes.
Write one byte beyond the requested offset.
Accept a write exceeding the configured payload budget.
Lose the captured VMM state while retaining volume data.
Accept a handoff layout with the wrong volume size.
Accept a started VMM that omits a handed-off memory region.
Replace a successfully served source page with zeros.

Return zeros instead of volume bytes when the page source fails. Only a campaign whose faults take a source away mid-stream falls back at all, which is why this is the generated schedule's entry rather than the recorded scenario's.
Leave the source sealed or paused after an abandoned migration.
Give a handoff up after its first failed receive while the source still holds its pages. The swizzle campaign's separated links fail a first receive on every seed, so this is its entry.

Keep waiting on a listed source nothing can reach after its hold is over, a migration's source or a fork's parent's host. Only a source cut off while still listed leaves the hold as the one evidence, and no campaign draws that fault, so the two scenarios are its entry. Each fails alone.

Send a handoff's next receive while a host still reports an earlier one in flight. Only a receive whose caller hung up is in flight when a retry looks, and no campaign draws that fault, so the scenario is its entry.

Report every page of a handoff's set as the source's for the peer backing's whole life, which told a fork's child that pages it had published had no object. Only a destination checkpointed while its source still serves retires one of them, which is why this is that scenario's entry.

Report a page of a handoff's set as the source's while the volume names a checkpoint from before the handoff, which a hole always seems to be, so a page of zeros the destination published and retired is loaded as the source's own.

Ask the source for every page a destination loads, including one it published since the handoff, which answers with the version the guest wrote past. Only a destination whose arena gives back a page it published while its source still serves loads one.
Forget that evicted private bytes exist in scratch storage. Only the buggified campaign evicts enough to spill, so this is the entry the per-site injection made detectable.
Lose loaded or copied data when creating a resident page.
Locate every member at the start of its part.
Reclaim the checkpoints the selected one still reads from.
Reclaim a kept checkpoint no fork was taken from, as if only pins protected anything.
Compact a parent's checkpoint into its child, which bills the child for the parent's page.
Accept a Starter's snapshot load request that names a key this package loads. Linux only, as root.
Leave the prepared directory and its sockets to this process instead of the placement's Owner. Linux only, as root.
Give the VMM host paths instead of the placement's Within. Linux only, as root.
Let a Starter prepare one launch twice. Linux only, as root.
Admit a memory session from a process other than the VMM its Starter reported. Linux only, as root.
